{{Youmay|the harness used with Sith warbirds|[[Mandalorian battle harness/Legends|Mandalorian battle harness]]}}
[[File:SithWarbird.jpg|thumb|right|200px|A sith warbird wearing a battle harness]]
A '''battle harness''' was a technological device used to enhance the use of [[Sith warbird]]s as [[Artillery/Legends|artillery]] mounts for the military forces of the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]]. They were [[Armor/Legends|armored]], and contained a [[Cockpit/Legends|cockpit]] to house the rider, [[rein]]s for controlling the warbird, and carried a [[Blaster cannon/Legends|blaster cannon]] supported by a [[Fusion generator/Legends|fusion generator]] that was comparable in capability to the later [[E-Web heavy repeating blaster/Legends|E-Web heavy repeating blaster]].<ref name="TSC">{{GamerCite|5|The Sith Compendium}}</ref>
